comment: Hand-crafted: an organization restricts OAuth apps and has not approved GitHub CLI. GitHub answers 200 with FORBIDDEN and the field null; message as GitHub words it.

errors.message: Although you appear to have the correct authorization credentials, the `acme` organization has enabled OAuth App access restrictions, meaning that data access to third-parties is limited.
